name: Default
shortDescription: Cron job and background task monitoring that alerts you when scheduled jobs fail to check in on time, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Set ADMIN_EMAIL to an address you own before the first deploy. The first start creates a superuser with that email and the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD; changing the email or password later emails a confirmation code to that address.
Email alerts, email login links and account changes need SMTP: fill in EMAIL_HOST and the other EMAIL_* variables, then redeploy.
